title: Projektetage Disposition Drag Cursor Sync
description: Fix projektetage disposition drag: dragging a tiny bit shoots the disposition very far instead of staying synchronized with the cursor.
summary:
Fixed hypersensitive canvas disposition drag on projektetage positioned slides.

Root cause: canvasDispositionDragContentStyle positioned content with absolute left/top plus width/height 100%, so the box extended past the wrapper (e.g. left 37.5% + width 100% = 137.5% wide) and small pointer deltas looked like huge jumps.

Fix: pure move drags apply translate3d(% of wrapper) on content while the wrapper keeps the declared frame; resize still uses absolute sizing when width/height change. Pointer deltas for canvas/resize use stable gesture placement bounds. Clamped sectionVisualScale for flow drags.

55 renderer tests pass.
